Without a pre-existing structure, you may need to be more intentional and reflective about what truly matters to you. It's also worth noting that not having a traditional religious or cultural framework can allow for more flexibility and adaptability. You may be more open to exploring different experiences, trying new things, and adjusting your priorities as you grow and learn.
